Usage: terraform [global options] <subcommand> [args]

Global Options:
  -chdir=DIR        Switch to a different working directory before executing
  -help             Show this help output
  -version          An alias for the "version" subcommand

Subcommands:
  init              Initialize Terraform in the current directory
  plan              Generate and show an execution plan
  apply             Apply changes to reach the desired infrastructure state
  destroy           Destroy Terraform-managed infrastructure
  output            Show output values from your state
  state             Advanced state manipulation
  fmt               Rewrite config files to canonical format
  validate          Validate config files for syntax and internal consistency
  console           Interactive console for evaluating expressions
  import            Import existing infrastructure into Terraform state
  workspace         Workspace management

Options:
  -no-color         Disable terminal colors for any output
  -compact-warnings Only show the first line of each warning
